saw_lines: Press-on nails get chosen by wear time and application speed, so buyers compare those two things first.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, and your ads carry no number a buyer can check.
Your 30 live ads show no proof number, so collect one review count or orders shipped figure and open the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 7 Nov 2026
points: Nothing in your 30 live ads gives a new buyer a number to check, like a review count or orders shipped. Without one, the nail set reads as a guess. Collect one real figure and open the next batch with it.

2 of 13 copy ads are creator posts, yet they run from your brand page and read like a company talking. Buyers trust the person who used the product. Whitelist both from the creator accounts and cut three variations each.
5 of 13 copy ads open on the same “die beste erfindung” line, so they bid against each other for the same buyers. Test two fresh openers, one on wear time and one on the 7 minute application.
17 of 30 ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so buyers see products without a reason to stop. Add three story videos of a hand applying a set, with the 3 week wear on screen.

ads_1: Hand-applied press-on videos led by wear time, tested against the opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and TikTok
